feeding_claim.verbatim: This means they are raised entirely on pasture from birth to harvest & never fed grain at any stage.

notes: Large Oahu ranch that also runs tours. Checked 2026-11-15: meet our herds, farmers market and dine and shop pages. The herds page says all cattle are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished, raised on pasture from birth to harvest and never fed grain, on about 1,700 acres, so the category is grass-finished. Beef is sold only at the KualoaGrown Market in the Ranch House building, open daily 10am to 5pm (market phone 808-748-3238), walk-in only; the site says it takes no pre-orders and does not ship. The market sells grass-fed and finished beef jerky and lists grass-fed beef as a category, without itemized cuts or prices. Other ranch animals are not listed because the site does not say their meat is sold.
